versions.subject: feat: add rules related to Barracuda ESG exploitation
versions.detection:
selection:
    Image|endswith: '/openssl'
    CommandLine|re: '[0-9]{1,3}\.[0-9]{1,3}\.[0-9]{1,3}\.[0-9]{1,3}'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - 's_client'
        - '-quiet'
        - '-connect'
    CommandLine|contains:
        - ':443'
        - ':8080'
condition: selection
versions.spl: Image="*/openssl" CommandLine="*s_client*" CommandLine="*-quiet*" CommandLine="*-connect*" CommandLine IN ("*:443*", "*:8080*") | regex CommandLine="[0-9]{1,3}\\.[0-9]{1,3}\\.[0-9]{1,3}\\.[0-9]{1,3}"
